name: Jean-Noël Barrot
bio: Jean-Noël Barrot is a French (and Swiss) economist and politician of the Mouvement Démocrate (MoDem) who has served as Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs since 21 September 2024, a position he retained through the Barnier, Bayrou and Lecornu governments, including after the 26 February 2026 reshuffle. The son of former minister and European commissioner Jacques Barrot, he previously served as Minister Delegate for European Affairs (Feb–Sept 2024) and Minister Delegate for the Digital Transition and Telecommunications (2022–2024), and represents the 2nd constituency of Yvelines in the National Assembly. A former professor at MIT's Sloan School of Management and at HEC Paris, his research focuses on finance, production networks and the evaluation of business-support public policies.
